policy: All 316 ordinary nonfoil cards replayed through production Canvas; 18 exact source/geometry groups.

stock.policy: Calibration-only outer stock medians, equal name weight within materials and equal material weight. Fixed bands exclude rounded corners and the printed interior. No renderer pixels drive the target. These are display-reference scan margins, not physical ink measurements.
